Ask for a chart or diagram in ordin"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ary language; the model understands the intent, chooses the appropriate native engine, emits a decla"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"rative payload, and the result appears directly in the conversation as an interactive canvas."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It is built for a near-native ECharts and Mermaid authoring experience—not a small set of hand-drawn"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" chart templates. The browser receives a real ECharts option or Mermaid source and renders it with the real engine."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### From a request to a native canvas"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Describe the visualization you need in ordinary language. `dsh-artifact` keeps the complete workflow"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" inside the conversation: the model reasons about the request, prepares a native engine payload, and"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" renders the result as an interactive canvas with appearance controls and PNG export."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"One request, from streamed reasoning and tool execution to a native ECharts calendar heatmap. The de"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"monstration preserves the actual DeepSeek Harness interface."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Built around real rendering engines"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| | Capability |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| **Native engines** | ECharts 6, the official ECharts-GL extension when an option needs it, and Mer"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"maid 11 |
| **Broad ECharts coverage** | Native JSON-expressible series and components: cartesian, p"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ie, radar, calendar heatmap, graph, sankey, tree, map, parallel, timeline, `dataset`, `visualMap`, `"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"dataZoom`, and more |
| **Diagram-first Mermaid** | Flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, gantt, j"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ourney, pie, and other Mermaid-supported diagrams |
| **Interactive canvas** | Tooltips, legends, zo"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"om, pan, 3D controls, and responsive resizing come from the actual renderer |
| **Appearance control"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"s** | In-canvas ECharts-inspired palettes and light/dark backgrounds; photographic globes retain the"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"ir real-world surface and expose background mode only |
| **Image download** | Download ECharts, ECh"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"arts-GL, and Mermaid canvases as 2× PNG images using the active background; standard ECharts and Mer"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"maid diagrams also support SVG download |
| **Safe by design** | Pure JSON across the declarative bo"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"undary; isolated custom HTML runs in a CSP-restricted sandbox iframe |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Install the DeepSeek Harness CLI first (one time):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"If this is your first time using DSH, run `dsh web` once to initialize the web profile, then stop it"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" before adding the plugin."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Start or restart `dsh web`, then hard-refresh the browser (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R`). `pnpm` must be avail"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"able on `PATH` because the DSH plugin command uses it internally."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Use it naturally"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Ask for the result you need. For example:"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"> Compare quarterly revenue and margin for 2024 in a dual-axis chart, highlight the best quarter, an"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"d use a dark canvas."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"> Create a GitHub-style calendar heatmap for this year's daily commits."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"> Draw a sequence diagram for OAuth login with success and failure paths."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The model calls `render_artifact` and returns a live canvas in the conversation. Use the **Appearanc"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"e** control to switch palette/background where appropriate, and the adjacent **Download** action to "},{"id":"p26s3","text":" to switch palette/background where appropriate, and the adjacent **Download** action to save a PNG."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Engine contract"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### `render_artifact`"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Parameter | Type | Purpose |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| `engine` | string | `echarts` (default) or `mermaid` |
| `option` | object / string | A native ECh"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"arts option for `echarts`; pure JSON only, no JavaScript functions |
| `maps` | object / string | Op"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"tional legal GeoJSON/SVG registry for ECharts `geo` and `map` visualizations |
| `code` | string | M"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"ermaid source for `mermaid` |
| `theme` | string | `auto`, `tech-blue`, `minimal`, `night-purple`, `"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"forest`, or `amber` |
| `mode` | string | `auto`, `light`, or `dark` |
| `title` | string | Conversa"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"tion card title |
| `height` | number | Canvas height in px (default `360`, minimum `120`) |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The plugin passes ECharts options to `setOption` without translating them into a preset catalogue. Prefer ECharts string templates such a"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"s `{c}%` for formatters. | `title` |"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" string | Conversation card title |
| `height` | number | Canvas height in px (default `400`, minimu"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"Conversation card title |
